title: [Peek] Add preview support for EML and MSG email files

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The first baseline harness build stopped with five CS8632 errors from nullable annotations in the linked parser. Enabling nullable context in the private project removed those errors, but a second assigned baseline build exited one with CS8604 and CS8625 warnings-as-errors in two test files. Both sequences passed source and asset guards and released their single validation lock. No test discovery, executed cases, TRX or candidate parser substitution occurred; the product parser remains pristine. A narrowly scoped private harness correction is being prepared without suppressions or product edits. Baseline and candidate validation remain unfinished; neither failure is an established upstream defect.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
